data.description:
# Ship configuration file: load and save values

## Problem statement

Ship tuning values (thrust acceleration, max speed, ship size, thrust flame length, colours) are currently hard-coded as constants in src/core/constants.ts (GDD §2.2 Newtonian-drift model). There is no way to persist tuned values to a file, which blocks the gym-scene slider work item that needs to write slider values back to a config file.

## User stories

- As a developer/tuner, I want ship values to live in a config file that the game reads at startup, so I can tweak values without editing code.
- As a developer/tuner, I want to write the current values back to that config file, so a save action in the gym scene persists my tuning session.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Config file source of truth:** Ship configuration values (at minimum: thrust acceleration, max speed, ship size, thrust flame length) are loaded from a config file at game startup when the file exists.
- [ ] **AC2 — Fallback defaults:** When no config file exists, the game uses the existing built-in constants from src/core/constants.ts (no crash, no missing values).
- [ ] **AC3 — Save mechanism:** A saveShipConfig(values) API writes the supplied values to the config file (location/format decided; JSON expected).
- [ ] **AC4 — Round-trip:** Loading a config file that was previously saved reproduces the saved values exactly.
- [ ] **AC5 — Integration point:** The config module exposes a typed interface matching the ship config fields so the gym scene's slider work item can read and write through it.
- [ ] **AC6 — Tests:** Unit tests cover load-when-present, load-when-absent (fallback), and save round-trip.

## Design questions (resolve during intake/plan)

- This is a browser game (Phaser, web-first per GDD §6.3). Where does the config file live?
  - Option A: a JSON file in public/ fetched at startup (read-only to browser; save triggers a local JSON download).
  - Option B: localStorage-backed persistence (read/write without server).
  - Operator decision needed; recommendation: Option B for the save button to truly persist, Option A for values in an editable file. May combine (A for defaults shipped, B for user overrides).

## Key Files

- src/core/constants.ts — source of the current hard-coded values that must become configurable.
- src/utils/movement.ts — consumes thrust/maxSpeed via MovementConfig.
- src/entities/Player.ts — consumes the constants (SHIP_SIZE, colours, THRUST_ACCELERATION, MAX_SPEED).

## Dependency

This item is a prerequisite for the gym sliders + save-button work item (parent task depends on this).
